title: Indices in a Tseitin clause chain
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let the original literals and auxiliary literals be finite lists of literals on the $n$ coordinates. If a clause belongs to the clause chain generated from these two lists and a literal belongs to that clause, then the literal's coordinate index occurs among the indices of the original literals or among the indices of the auxiliary literals.
hypotheses_covered: a clause belonging to the generated clause chain
a literal belonging to that clause
